source:
.data
n:  .word 5
.text
main:
    lw   a0, n
    jal  ra, square_plus_one
    li   a7, 1
    ecall
    li   a0, 42
    li   a7, 93
    ecall
square_plus_one:
    addi sp, sp, -8
    sw   ra, 4(sp)
    sw   s0, 0(sp)
    mv   s0, a0
    mul  a0, s0, s0
    addi a0, a0, 1
    lw   s0, 0(sp)
    lw   ra, 4(sp)
    addi sp, sp, 8
    ret
caption: Memory tab jumped to sp, showing the saved s0 and ra in the stack frame
shot_note: Breakpoint on "mv s0, a0" stops when it is fetched; 4 more cycles are clocked so both sw instructions have written the stack frame (ra=0x0c at sp+4, s0=0 at sp).

source:
# Sum N words of an array, visiting every STRIDE-th word.
.equ N, 64          # number of loads
.equ STRIDE, 1      # in words: try 1, 2, 4, 8
.data
arr:    .zero 2048  # 512 words
.text
main:
    la   t0, arr
    li   t1, N
    li   t2, STRIDE
    slli t2, t2, 2      # stride in bytes
    li   a0, 0
loop:
    lw   t3, 0(t0)
    add  a0, a0, t3
    add  t0, t0, t2
    addi t1, t1, -1
    bnez t1, loop
    li   a7, 10
    ecall
caption: Cache tab overview: configuration, cache table view, statistics and hit-rate plot after the stride program

source:
# Traverse a 16x16 word matrix row by row (ROWMAJOR=1) or column by column (ROWMAJOR=0)
.equ DIM, 16
.equ ROWMAJOR, 1
.data
mat:    .zero 1024      # 16*16*4 bytes
.text
main:
    la   s0, mat
    li   s1, DIM
    li   t0, 0              # i
outer:
    li   t1, 0              # j
inner:
    li   t4, ROWMAJOR
    beqz t4, colmajor
    mul  t2, t0, s1         # row-major: index = i*DIM + j
    add  t2, t2, t1
    j    access
colmajor:
    mul  t2, t1, s1         # column-major: index = j*DIM + i
    add  t2, t2, t0
access:
    slli t2, t2, 2
    add  t2, s0, t2
    lw   t3, 0(t2)
    addi t3, t3, 1
    sw   t3, 0(t2)
    addi t1, t1, 1
    blt  t1, s1, inner
    addi t0, t0, 1
    blt  t0, s1, outer
    li   a7, 10
    ecall
caption: Hit-rate plot with moving average for the matrix traversal program

source:
# Light the LED matrix diagonal red, then the first row blue.
.text
main:
    li   s0, LED_MATRIX_0_BASE
    li   s1, LED_MATRIX_0_WIDTH
    li   s2, LED_MATRIX_0_HEIGHT
    li   t0, 0
diag:
    bge  t0, s1, row
    bge  t0, s2, row
    mul  t1, t0, s1
    add  t1, t1, t0
    slli t1, t1, 2
    add  t1, s0, t1
    li   t2, 0xFF0000
    sw   t2, 0(t1)
    addi t0, t0, 1
    j    diag
row:
    li   t0, 1
row_loop:
    bge  t0, s1, end
    slli t1, t0, 2
    add  t1, s0, t1
    li   t2, 0x0000FF
    sw   t2, 0(t1)
    addi t0, t0, 1
    j    row_loop
end:
    li   a7, 10
    ecall
caption: LED matrix with a red diagonal and a blue first row

source:
# Move a white dot around the LED matrix with the D-pad
.text
main:
    li   s0, LED_MATRIX_0_BASE
    li   s1, LED_MATRIX_0_WIDTH
    li   s2, LED_MATRIX_0_HEIGHT
    li   s3, 0              # x
    li   s4, 0              # y
    li   s5, 0xFFFFFF       # white
draw:
    mul  t0, s4, s1         # offset = (y*WIDTH + x) * 4
    add  t0, t0, s3
    slli t0, t0, 2
    add  s6, s0, t0         # s6 = address of the dot
    sw   s5, 0(s6)
poll:
    li   t1, D_PAD_0_UP
    lw   t2, 0(t1)
    bnez t2, up
    li   t1, D_PAD_0_DOWN
    lw   t2, 0(t1)
    bnez t2, down
    li   t1, D_PAD_0_LEFT
    lw   t2, 0(t1)
    bnez t2, left
    li   t1, D_PAD_0_RIGHT
    lw   t2, 0(t1)
    bnez t2, right
    j    poll
up:
    beqz s4, poll
    addi s4, s4, -1
    j    move
down:
    addi t3, s2, -1
    bge  s4, t3, poll
    addi s4, s4, 1
    j    move
left:
    beqz s3, poll
    addi s3, s3, -1
    j    move
right:
    addi t3, s1, -1
    bge  s3, t3, poll
    addi s3, s3, 1
move:
    sw   zero, 0(s6)        # erase the old dot
    j    draw
caption: D-Pad and LED matrix widgets side by side with the white dot
shot_note: No D-Pad key is pressed, so the white dot stays at (0,0) in the top-left corner. Sub-windows placed with mdiwin so both are visible.

source:
# Draw a colour gradient on the Screen and present it
.text
main:
    li   s0, SCREEN_0_BASE
    li   s1, SCREEN_0_WIDTH
    li   s2, SCREEN_0_HEIGHT
    li   t0, 0              # y
row:
    li   t1, 0              # x
col:
    slli t2, t1, 18         # red   = x * 4 (in bits 23:16)
    slli t3, t0, 10         # green = y * 4 (in bits 15:8)
    or   t2, t2, t3
    mul  t4, t0, s1         # offset = (y*WIDTH + x) * 4
    add  t4, t4, t1
    slli t4, t4, 2
    add  t4, s0, t4
    sw   t2, 0(t4)
    addi t1, t1, 1
    blt  t1, s1, col
    addi t0, t0, 1
    blt  t0, s2, row
    li   t5, SCREEN_0_PRESENT
    sw   zero, 0(t5)        # any write to PRESENT shows the frame
    li   a7, 10
    ecall
caption: Screen peripheral showing the colour gradient after PRESENT
